The mood conveyed in the text is eerie, melancholic, and ominous. The description of the "dark and unwelcoming" windows, the "howling" wind, and the personification of the house as "lamenting" its slumber creates an atmosphere of isolation and foreboding. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a sense of mystery and tension, suggesting that the setting holds secrets or past traumas that are about to be revealed or explored.
